intent: Generate new artwork; reference only the supplied image's tactile printmaking, negative space and restrained palette, not its scenes or mechanics.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite atlas for an original minimalist top-down sailing game, "Margin Tide / 余白航路".
Primary request: SIX separate handmade Japanese sumi-ink archipelago shapes on a truly TRANSPARENT background, arranged in a precise 3-column by 2-row regular grid on a 1536x1024 canvas. Each cell is 512x512. Every island is centered inside its cell and completely contained in the central 400x400 region with transparent padding, and never touches another cell.
Art direction: tactile, sophisticated contemporary woodcut / etching meets washi paper and sumi-e. Dense very dark indigo almost-black bodies with exquisite fine curved pale brass contour lines and sparse engraved cross-hatching inside, feathered dry-brush edges, mineral pigment pooling and organic ink bleed. Restrained, beautiful editorial artwork, not pixel art, not flat vector icons. View perfectly overhead, shapes completely flat on paper, no perspective.
The six forms are different organic compact rounded rocks / ink-blots: 1 rounded oval with a short inlet, 2 wide bean shape, 3 compact triangular pebble, 4 rounded crescent-like solid blob (shallow concavity only), 5 irregular broad lozenge, 6 small overlapping circular lobes. Each must have a substantially solid dark center suitable as an obstacle. Do not make donut holes. No mountains, no foliage, no buildings, no boats, no characters, no shadows, no scenery, no UI, no text or labels, no grid lines. The exterior around each island is transparent, not white, not parchment. The islands should be clearly separated by ample transparent margins. Export as one transparent PNG atlas.
